demo.title: Demo line
demo.line1: Words that stand on solid ground
demo.line2: Walk around them, they stay put
demo.line3: Every line a block of light
demo.line4: Sing it back and watch it fall

billboard.name: Billboard
billboard.desc: Huge, thick road-side letters, lit only by the world.

marquee.name: Marquee
marquee.desc: A warm theater arch with twinkling bulbs and a sweeping band.

neon_tube.name: Neon Tube
neon_tube.desc: A thin pink tube, all light, that stutters as it burns.

chrome.name: Chrome
chrome.desc: Curved heavy metal with silver running over it, then it shatters.

ember.name: Ember
ember.desc: Hot coals on charred sides that smoulder and blow away as ash.

glacier.name: Glacier
glacier.desc: Stacked blocks of pale ice that slowly breathe.

graffiti.name: Graffiti
graffiti.desc: A loud marker tag in a black keyline, climbing like stairs.

typewriter.name: Typewriter
typewriter.desc: Small flat type struck key by key; sung words turn ribbon red.

holo.name: Holo
holo.desc: A cyan projection with no body, seen through walls, glitching.

arcade.name: Arcade
arcade.desc: Chunky yellow pixels that hop and turn pink as they are sung.

vapor.name: Vapor
vapor.desc: Very wide-set pastel capitals rolling on a slow wave.

poster_stack.name: Poster Stack
poster_stack.desc: Tall red capitals packed in rows; the sung word steps out.

stone.name: Stone
stone.desc: Deep carved gray letters that land with weight and sink back.

candy.name: Candy
candy.desc: A plump sweet script in a white keyline, bouncing and sparkling.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.desc: A pale bodiless serif that hangs, drifts and shows through walls.

disco.name: Disco
disco.desc: A fat script in a racing rainbow, every letter circling.

sleeve.name: Sleeve
sleeve.desc: Takes its colors from the album cover, with a slow ripple.

gold_leaf.name: Gold Leaf
gold_leaf.desc: A thin gilded shopfront script on an arch, catching the light.

blockhead.name: Blockhead
blockhead.desc: The game's own lettering in grass and dirt, as thick as a block.

relay.name: Relay
relay.desc: A new color for each line, in rows stepping back in depth.

menu.title: Lyrica
menu.hint: The line standing in the world is your preview. Esc closes.
menu.reset_all.desc: Puts back every value you changed, on all pages but Staff. Your saved looks stay.

looks.name: A name
looks.name.desc: Saves type, color, solid form, light and motion under a name. The same name replaces the old one.

saved_row.desc: One of your saved looks. Place, sync and card stay as they are when you put it on.

type.bold.desc: The heavy cut of the font.
type.size.desc: How big the letters are. At 1.00 they stand about one block tall.
type.line_gap.desc: Extra room between the rows of a wrapped line.
type.wrap_width.desc: How wide a row may get, in pixels of the font, before the line wraps.

colour.mode.desc: One color, a gradient, a rainbow, colors from the album cover, or a new color for each line.
colour.flow.desc: How fast the colors run through the letters.
colour.first.desc: The color of the letters, or where a gradient starts.
colour.second.desc: Where a gradient ends. Sung letters take it with the Fill style of karaoke.

solid.depth.desc: How thick the letters are as objects. At 0 they are flat.
solid.side_shade.desc: How bright the sides of the letters are next to their faces. Lower is darker.
solid.bend.desc: Curves the line toward you: the ends come forward and turn inward.
solid.outline.desc: A thin silhouette around the face of each letter.
solid.self_lit.desc: Ignores the world's light, so the words do not dim at night or in caves.
solid.shadow.desc: A soft shadow on the ground under the line.
solid.through_walls.desc: Shows a faint copy of the words where blocks would hide them.
solid.sparkles.desc: A few small twinkles on the edges of the letters.
solid.glow.desc: Light around each letter, in the letter's own shape, that goes with it wherever its motion takes it.
solid.glow_reach.desc: How far the light goes out from the letters.
solid.glow_mode.desc: The halo takes the color of the letters, or one of its own.

motion.arrange.desc: How the words of a line are set: rows, a big first word, steps in depth, an arch or a poster stack.
motion.enter.desc: How a line arrives. Click a side or turn the wheel.
motion.exit.desc: How a line leaves. Click a side or turn the wheel.
motion.idle.desc: What a line does while it stands there. Click a side or turn the wheel.
motion.idle_speed.desc: How fast the idle motion goes.
motion.idle_amount.desc: How far the idle motion goes.
motion.karaoke.desc: Follows the singing along the line, by word timings when the lyrics have them.
motion.karaoke_style.desc: Unsung letters dark, a bright band passing, sung letters in the second color, or the sung letter stepping out.

place.place.desc: On the ground, floating, in the sky, on a block you look at, on the floor, around you, left standing behind you, or flat on the screen.
place.distance.desc: How many blocks ahead of you a new line takes its spot.
place.height_add.desc: Raises or lowers the line, in blocks.
place.spread.desc: How far lines wander left and right of each other.
place.facing.desc: Fixed: a line keeps its direction and you can walk around it. Turn: it slowly turns to you like a heavy sign.
place.carry.desc: When you move faster than a sprint, by elytra or vehicle, the line comes along instead of staying behind.
place.trail_length.desc: How many old lines stay standing with Trail.
place.screen_spot.desc: Where on the screen the words sit with Screen.
place.screen_size.desc: How big the words are on the screen.

card.on.desc: The now-playing card on the screen.
card.style.desc: A thin strip, a turning record, a large cover, or one line running along the screen edge.
card.corner.desc: The corner of the screen the card sits in. You can also drag the card anywhere above this desk.
card.back_to_corner.desc: Forgets where the card was dragged to.
card.cover.desc: Shows the cover on the card.
card.times.desc: Shows how far the song is and how long it runs.
card.line.desc: Shows the line being sung on the card.

head.own.desc: The song you are playing, on a card over your head. Others see it only if you share it.
head.paused.desc: Show keeps the card up and says it is paused. Hide takes the card away until the song plays again, for you and for everyone you share with.
head.place.desc: Whether song cards stand over the name or under it. This goes for every card you see, on you and on others, and only on your game.
head.preview.desc: Turns the camera to face you while this page is open, with your card over your head. It goes by LabyMod's Show Own Name.
head.share.desc: Sends what you are playing to other players of this addon over LabyConnect, so they see it over your head.
head.share_cover.desc: Sends a small copy of the cover along with the song.
head.show_shared.desc: Shows the songs other players share over their heads.
head.show_shared_covers.desc: Shows the covers other players send along.
head.sharing_note: Sent: the song's name, where it is and whether it plays. Nothing goes out until you switch it on.
head.cover.desc: The song's cover at the left of the card.
head.wave.desc: The song's wave along the bottom of the card.
head.time.desc: The song's time at the top right of the card.
head.sources.desc: All apps reads whatever plays on your PC, including browsers. Spotify only reads nothing from any other app. The Spotify website counts as your browser, so it needs the Spotify app.
head.title: Long titles
head.title.desc: What every song card you see does with a long title, on you and on others. Slide moves the whole title past, Shorten ends it in dots, and Full makes the card wide enough. This goes only for your game: everyone else chooses for themselves.
head.accent_from.desc: The part of the wave that has played, and the word Paused. Static is one color of your choice on every card. Album takes each song's color from its cover. Either way a role's words keep the role's own color, and this goes only for your game.
head.accent.desc: The color the wave takes when it is static.
head.own_role.desc: Your own role on your own game. Off hides it from you only: other players still see it unless the role is set to Hidden on the Staff page.
head.opacity.desc: How solid the panel behind the words is, from fully solid to not there at all.
head.panel_color.desc: The color of the panel. On a bright, solid panel the words turn dark.
head.rim.desc: A one-pixel edge around the panel, so that its shape holds on any background.
head.corners.desc: How round the panel's corners and the cover's are, from square up.
head.size.desc: How big the card is close up. Further away it keeps the size its text needs.

staff.badges.desc: The roles of Lyrica team members, on every player you see. Off hides all of them, on your game only. Songs still show.
staff.copy.desc: Copies the whole list as it stands. Paste it over the published file to send it to everyone.
staff.publish_note: Changes show on your own game now. They reach other players, and decide who has this page, once the copied list is in the published file, with no new jar. Games read that file every 10 minutes.
staff.published.saved: Published list: out of reach, using the last copy saved here.
staff.published.jar: Published list: out of reach, using the one in this jar.
staff.discard.desc: Forgets every change on this PC, which leaves the list as it is published.
staff.preview.desc: Turns the camera to face you while this page is open, with this title under your name. It goes by LabyMod's Show Own Name and by Show titles.
staff.show_title.desc: Off leaves the role's words alone under the name.
staff.title_text.desc: The player's own title beside the role's words. Empty means none.
staff.own_label.desc: This player's own words instead of the role's. Empty gives them the role's.
staff.panel_access.desc: Whether this player may open this page. As role goes by what their role says; Yes and No go over it.
staff.role_name.desc: The name you know this role by, like dev. Players never see it, and it changes nothing they see.
staff.role_label.desc: The words players see under the name, like Developer.
staff.role_color.desc: The color of the words under the name.
staff.role_panel.desc: Whether players of this role may open this page and change this list.
staff.kind.desc: Bare words under the name, or words on a little card.
staff.opacity.desc: How solid the panel behind the words is, from fully solid to not there at all.
staff.panel_color.desc: The color of the panel. On a bright, solid panel the words turn dark.
staff.rim.desc: A one-pixel edge around the panel, so that its shape holds on any background.
staff.corners.desc: How round the panel's corners are, from square up.
staff.size.desc: How big the title is close up. Further away it keeps the size its text needs.
staff.place.desc: Under the name, on its own. Or on the song card, with the song, and over the name when no song plays. Or hidden, which takes it off the player for everyone once the list is published. The song card stays.
staff.new_role_name.desc: The name you know this role by, like dev. One word.
staff.new_role_words.desc: The words players see under the name, like Developer.
staff.add_role.desc: Adds this role to the list. It starts with no access to this page.
staff.new_player_name.desc: The player's Minecraft name. It is looked up, and a name without an account is refused.
staff.new_player_role.desc: Which role the new player gets.
staff.add_player.desc: Adds this account to the list under the chosen role.

role_row.desc: Players see this role as: %s. A small square means it may open this page. Pressing x twice removes the role with its players.

player_row.desc: The title goes by the account id, not this name. A small square means they may open this page. Pressing x twice removes them.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the whole addon on or off: whatever your PC is playing, its words as solid letters in the world. How they look is set in the Lyrica menu.

spotifyOnly.name: Spotify only
spotifyOnly.description: Reads nothing from any other app, such as your browser. The Spotify website plays in your browser, so this needs the Spotify app.

showLyrics.name: Show lyrics
showLyrics.description: The main switch for the words.

hideWhenPaused.name: Hide when paused
hideWhenPaused.description: Takes the words away while the song is paused.

karaoke.name: Karaoke
karaoke.description: Follows the singing along the line, by word timings when the lyrics have them.

earlierLines.name: Earlier lines
earlierLines.description: How many lines already sung stay above the current one.

nextLine.name: Next line
nextLine.description: Shows the line that comes next, smaller, under the current one.

breakDots.name: Break dots
breakDots.description: A countdown of solid dots during long instrumental breaks.

syncAllMs.name: Sync, all songs
syncAllMs.description: Moves the lyrics of every song, in milliseconds. More means the words come earlier.

showCard.name: Show the card
showCard.description: The now-playing card on the screen.

cardCover.name: Album cover
cardCover.description: Shows the cover on the card.

cardTimes.name: Times
cardTimes.description: Shows how far the song is and how long it runs.

cardLine.name: Current lyric
cardLine.description: Shows the line being sung on the card.

ownCard.name: Over my head
ownCard.description: The song you are playing, on a card over your head. Others see it only if you share it.

shareSong.name: Share my song
shareSong.description: Sends what you are playing to other players of this addon over LabyConnect, so they see it over your head.

showShared.name: See others' songs
showShared.description: Shows the songs other players share over their heads.

teamRoles.name: Show team roles
teamRoles.description: The roles of Lyrica team members, on every player you see. Off hides all of them, on your game only.

menuKey.name: Menu key
menuKey.description: Opens the Lyrica menu: Looks, Type, Color, Solid, Motion, Place, Card and Over head.

syncEarlierKey.name: Sync earlier
syncEarlierKey.description: For words that come in late: shifts this song 100 ms ahead, and remembers it for next time.

syncLaterKey.name: Sync later
syncLaterKey.description: For words that come in early: shifts this song 100 ms back, and remembers it for next time.

hideKey.name: Hide lyrics
hideKey.description: Takes the words away or brings them back. The card stays where it is.

openMenu.name: Open the Lyrica menu
openMenu.description: Every setting for the look of the letters, the now-playing card and the song over your head lives there.
